claims.claim: Israel's standard VAT rate is 18% (raised from 17% on 1 January 2025 and still 18%); it drives every VAT line in the invoice template.
claims.raw_snippet: The 2025 current rate of VAT is 18%.

claims.claim: With VAT at 18%, gross = net*1.18, net = gross/1.18, and VAT on a VAT-inclusive price = gross - gross/1.18 = gross*0.18/1.18. The identities are arithmetic; only the 18% rate is external.
claims.raw_snippet: The 2025 current rate of VAT is 18%.
claims.note: The algebra (gross=net*(1+r), vat=gross*r/(1+r)) is definitional and has no external source; the cited snippet establishes r=0.18.
